title: Gingerbread Dragon Portal
description: A surreal fantasy scene on cracked red earth under a purple sky, featuring a large green multi-eyed creature holding a leaf and a small green dragon, standing before a glowing pink energy sphere containing a grid of gingerbread cookies and a large green dragon. In the background, a red-cloaked figure walks toward floating bubbles with more gingerbread figures.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting of a cracked red barren landscape with purple stormy sky and floating green leaves. In the foreground a large green multi-eyed spherical creature with many colored eyes holds a green leaf and stands next to a small green dragon. They face a giant glowing pink crackling energy sphere that contains a 3x3 grid of decorated gingerbread men cookies and a large green dragon inside. In the distance a small red cloaked figure walks on a path toward floating transparent bubbles containing more gingerbread figures, detailed fantasy illustration, vibrant colors
